subject: AthenaHealth SIG — Targeted Authn slices, bridge letter timeline & delivery plan
messages:
From: Marta Perez <marta.perez@trustmetrics.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: AthenaHealth Audit <audit@athenahealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: scoped MFA/session extracts + bridge letter for SIG review

Hi Connor,

Thanks for agreeing to help with the SIG/CAIQ follow-up for AthenaHealth. To complete our review and map controls referenced in the SOC 2 Type II, we need a few targeted artifacts beyond the report. Please confirm whether you can provide the following by the end of next week (Nov 12):

1) Authn log slices: monthly extracts covering 2027-05-01 through 2027-10-31 (UTC). Each extract should include: timestamp (UTC), user_id, principal_type (service/user), authn_method (password/sso/mfa), mfa_provider_id, outcome (success/failure), ip, session_id, and any associated SAML/OIDC assertion id where applicable. CSV format preferred.

2) MFA validation events specifically for privileged accounts (role: admin/infra/ops) for the same period — separate CSV or labelled column.

3) Evidence of periodic access reviews for privileged accounts (last two reviews): reviewer, review date, outcome, and remediation actions if any. A redacted export or PDF of the access review workbook is fine.

4) A short bridge letter confirming that the SOC 2 report covers the controls related to authentication and privileged access for the audit period noted, and whether there are any known control gaps or compensating controls we should be aware of.

If anything above is problematic (formatting, time window, or privacy constraints), tell us what you can provide and propose alternatives. We may request a short two-way NDA or secure upload location for raw logs.

Thanks — we just need enough detail to map to SIG/CAIQ items and validate the control operating effectiveness.

Best,
Marta Perez
Senior Security Assessor
TrustMetrics Audit Services

Attachments: sample_mfa_row_example.txt (example row illustrates fields we expect)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Perez <marta.perez@trustmetrics.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped MFA/session extracts + bridge letter for SIG review

On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 9:12 AM Marta Perez <marta.perez@trustmetrics.io> wrote:
> Hi Connor,
> 
> Thanks for agreeing to help with the SIG/CAIQ follow-up for AthenaHealth...

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. A few clarifying questions so we can scope the extraction and avoid over-sharing PII: 

- Confirm that the UTC window is inclusive of 2027-05-01 00:00:00 through 2027-10-31 23:59:59.
- For privileged accounts, do you want the role label exactly as our identity service calls it (we use admin, infra, svc-account), or would you prefer we map to "privileged" as a binary column?
- Are assertion payloads required, or just assertion IDs (we can provide full SAML assertion hashes on an as-needed basis under an NDA)?
- Preferred delivery: secure S3 share or encrypted Drive link? We can also provide a redacted sample mfa_log_sample.csv to confirm layout.

Plan: Laura will pull the authn/session extracts; Rishi will compile the access review artifacts and draft the bridge letter. We'll aim to send the samples by EOD Wed (Nov 3) and the full bundle by Nov 12 if the scope above is acceptable.

Connor O'Brien
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: authn_slice_layout.csv (schema), delivery_options.txt
From: Marta Perez <marta.perez@trustmetrics.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: AthenaHealth Audit <audit@athenahealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T10:46:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped MFA/session extracts + bridge letter for SIG review

Thanks, Connor — answers inline: 

- Yes, inclusive window as you stated (2027-05-01 00:00:00 to 2027-10-31 23:59:59 UTC).
- Binary "privileged" column is fine; we will rely on your mapping. If you can include your role mapping in a small readme, that helps.
- Assertion IDs only for now (we'll request full assertion payloads in a separate, justified ask if needed).
- Encrypted Drive link is preferred; please provide access instructions and any required requester emails.

Additionally: For the bridge letter, please state whether the SOC 2 Type II testing period aligns with the above window, and if not, include the tested period and a clear statement whether authentication and privileged access controls were included in the test population. A short paragraph on any interim changes to the MFA provider (if there were upgrades/rollouts) would also be helpful.

If you can deliver the sample CSV and bridge letter draft by Nov 3, we'll confirm scope and provide any final requests.

Regards,
Marta
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Perez <marta.perez@trustmetrics.io>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:30:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: scoped MFA/session extracts + bridge letter for SIG review — internal plan

Laura / Rishi — forwarding Marta's ask. Action items and proposed owners: 

1) Laura — pull authn/session slices for 2027-05 through 2027-10 (inclusive). Redact PII where possible (email hashes ok). Deliverables: monthly CSVs and a small readme that maps role labels to "privileged" binary. Please include mfa_provider_id and assertion_id columns as requested.

2) Rishi — compile privileged account access review exports: last two review cycles (dates, reviewers, remediation). Draft a bridge letter stating the SOC 2 reporting period and confirming whether authn/privileged access controls were in scope. I put a starter draft in the attachments (bridge_letter_draft.pdf).

3) Delivery: we'll upload to an encrypted Drive share and invite marta.perez@trustmetrics.io + audit@athenahealth.com. Connor will coordinate the link/permissions.

Timeline: sample CSV + draft bridge letter by EOD Wed Nov 3. Full bundle by Nov 12. If either of you see blockers (retention policy, format, or redaction scope), call it out today so we can escalate.

Thanks — Connor

--- Forwarded attachment list ---
1) authn_slice_layout.csv — column schema (sample attached)
2) bridge_letter_draft.pdf — draft language to be edited
3) mfa_log_sample.csv — anonymized 10-row example
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Connor — quick status:

- I pulled a redacted sample (mfa_log_sample.csv) and uploaded it to the secure folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/athena-prod-evidence/sample-mfa. The sample uses hashed emails and includes the requested columns. Marta — you should have access; if not I will invite the audit address.

- Full monthly slices (six files) will be ready for internal review by Nov 10. We need one small exception: one legacy service produced authn events stored in an archived bucket (pre-2027-06) — extraction will take an extra day. That means full bundle delivery moves to Nov 13 unless you can accept the archived slice arriving a day later.

- Rishi, I'm attaching the CSV layout and note that we map roles: admin, infra, devops => privileged = true.

Next steps: Rishi to finalize access review exports and update the bridge letter. I'll coordinate the final upload and permissioning (encrypted share + access expiration).

Laura Bennett
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
